Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

Depends on #45463; only the last commit is new in this PR.

Each cached-prefix prefill runs a separate replay forward before its extend.

## Modifications

- HIP sets `folds_encoder_swa_replay` from `SGLANG_HIP_FOLD_ENCODER_SWA_REPLAY` (default on).
- Extend and late-layer tail rows are floored at their request's replay start via `encoder_swa_row_floor`; MLP-sync padding rows get floor 0. Unit test added.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K 5-shot, 1319 questions, same setup: main 0.889 -> 0.897 with the series.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Measured with the full series (1/3-3/3) on 2x MI355X, TP2, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, DSpark, `--enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay`, AgentX trace replay c64 PDI 8: TTT/GPU 157,543 -> 174,697 (+10.9%), TPOT p50 13.95 -> 11.84 ms, P90 interactivity 57.3 -> 65.5.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -1763,6 +1763,9 @@ class Envs:
     SGLANG_HIP_DSV41_INDEX_K_PAGE8 = EnvBool(False)
     # DeepSeek-V4.1 mHC boundary (HIP): the 32-row Triton tile from _HC_BOUNDARY_WIDE_MIN_M rows (bitwise the same).
     SGLANG_HIP_MHC_BOUNDARY_WIDE_TILE = EnvBool(True)
+    # Encoder SWA replay on HIP: fold each hit's replay rows into its extend
+    # instead of running a separate replay forward first.
+    SGLANG_HIP_FOLD_ENCODER_SWA_REPLAY = EnvBool(True)
 
     # cache, GEMM, and distributed
     SGLANG_OPT_FP8_WO_A_GEMM = EnvBool(True)

@@ -884,6 +884,10 @@ class DeepseekV4HipRadixBackend(
 
     forward = DeepseekV4AttnBackend.forward
 
+    @property
+    def folds_encoder_swa_replay(self) -> bool:
+        return envs.SGLANG_HIP_FOLD_ENCODER_SWA_REPLAY.get()
+
     # the ratio-1/2 compressor and indexer orchestration is the CUDA backend's, taken
     # unbound; HIP differs only in the paged top-k (_low_ratio_index_topk below)
     forward_low_ratio_sources = DeepseekV4AttnBackend.forward_low_ratio_sources
@@ -991,6 +995,7 @@ def __init__(
         # exit_late_layer_tail.
         self.tail_source_kv_layer_id: Optional[int] = None
         self.encoder_replay = False
+        self.encoder_row_floor = None
         self.topk = get_spec().speculative_eagle_topk or 0
         assert self.topk in [0, 1], "MTP Topk > 1 not supported for DeepSeek V4"
         self.mtp_enabled = self.topk > 0
@@ -1018,6 +1023,10 @@ def __init__(
             # DSpark draft workers verify gamma rows; the server arg keeps the
             # CUDA-side convention gamma + 1.
             self.target_verify_num_draft_tokens = self.speculative_num_draft_tokens - 1
+        if self.token_to_kv_pool.swa_valid_from is not None:
+            assert self._uses_dspark_draft_window(), (
+                "the draft SWA ring is addressed only by the V4.1 DSpark block window"
+            )
         self._fp8_decode_num_heads = (
             model_runner.model_config.num_attention_heads // get_parallel().attn_tp_size
         )
@@ -1705,6 +1714,7 @@ def init_forward_metadata_in_graph(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> None:
             isinstance(metadata, DSV4Metadata)
             and forward_batch.out_cache_loc is not None
             and window is None
+            and self.token_to_kv_pool.swa_valid_from is None
         ):
             out_cache_loc = forward_batch.out_cache_loc
             if (
@@ -2094,6 +2104,7 @@ def _build_forward_metadata(
         use_prefill_cuda_graph: bool = False,
     ):
         self.encoder_replay = forward_batch.encoder_swa_replay
+        self.encoder_row_floor = forward_batch.encoder_swa_row_floor
         req_pool_indices = forward_batch.req_pool_indices
         seq_lens = forward_batch.seq_lens.to(torch.int32)
         seq_lens_cpu = forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu
@@ -2256,6 +2267,14 @@ def _build_late_layer_tail_metadata(
             device=device,
             whole_extend=late_layer_whole_extend(forward_batch, dspark=self.is_dspark),
         )
+        if self.encoder_row_floor is not None:
+            # Folded hits: a tail row never reads below its request's replay start.
+            row_floor = _cuda_backend._pad_rows(
+                self.encoder_row_floor, num_rows=forward_batch.out_cache_loc.shape[0]
+            )
+            swa_replay_start = torch.maximum(
+                swa_replay_start, row_floor[token_indices].to(swa_replay_start.dtype)
+            )
         contiguous_start = (
             extend_lens_cpu[0] - tail_lens_cpu[0] if len(extend_lens_cpu) == 1 else None
         )
@@ -3541,6 +3560,7 @@ def make_core_attn_metadata(
         raw_positions = seq_lens_casual - 1
 
         request_layout = None
+        swa_out_cache_loc = None
         window = self.token_to_kv_pool.request_window
         if window is not None:
             if self.encoder_replay:
@@ -3553,6 +3573,12 @@ def make_core_attn_metadata(
                 )
                 group_first = torch.cummax(torch.where(starts, offset, 0), dim=0).values
                 swa_replay_start = raw_positions - (offset - group_first)
+            elif swa_replay_start is None and self.encoder_row_floor is not None:
+                # Folded replay: hits floor every row at their replay start;
+                # MLP-sync padding rows follow the real ones with floor 0.
+                swa_replay_start = _cuda_backend._pad_rows(
+                    self.encoder_row_floor, num_rows=raw_positions.shape[0]
+                )
             request_layout = window_layout(
                 req_pool_indices_repeated,
                 raw_positions,
@@ -3578,6 +3604,11 @@ def make_core_attn_metadata(
                 out_loc=out_loc,
                 block_size=dspark_block_size,
             )
+            if self.token_to_kv_pool.swa_valid_from is not None:
+                swa_out_cache_loc = self._dspark_swa_ring_out_cache_loc(
+                    seq_lens_casual=seq_lens_casual,
+                    req_pool_indices_repeated=req_pool_indices_repeated,
+                )
         elif swa_replay_start is None:
             swa_page_indices = self.get_swa_page_indices(
                 seq_lens_casual=seq_lens_casual,
@@ -3620,6 +3651,7 @@ def make_core_attn_metadata(
             index_topk=self.index_topk,
             low_ratios=self.low_ratios,
             request_window_layout=request_layout,
+            swa_out_cache_loc=swa_out_cache_loc,
         )
 
         if need_compress:
@@ -3660,6 +3692,9 @@ def get_swa_page_indices(
         return swa_indices.to(torch.int32)
 
     get_dspark_swa_page_indices = DeepseekV4AttnBackend.get_dspark_swa_page_indices
+    _dspark_swa_ring_out_cache_loc = (
+        DeepseekV4AttnBackend._dspark_swa_ring_out_cache_loc
+    )
 
 
 class DeepseekV4MultiStepBackend(DeepseekV4HipRadixBackend):

@@ -134,9 +134,17 @@ def is_dspark_spec() -> bool:
 
 def uses_draft_swa_ring() -> bool:
     """Whether the DSpark draft keeps its SWA KV in a per-request ring, so no SWA
-    state is tree-owned under encoder replay. The HIP backend still addresses the
-    draft SWA through the target's paged full-to-SWA mapping."""
-    return get_exec().features.enable_encoder_swa_bounded_replay and not _is_hip
+    state is tree-owned under encoder replay. HIP unified_kv keeps the draft SWA in
+    its own (slot, position) ring instead."""
+    if not get_exec().features.enable_encoder_swa_bounded_replay:
+        return False
+    if _is_hip:
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4.unified_kv_gate import (
+            is_unified_kv_triton,
+        )
+
+        return not is_unified_kv_triton()
+    return True
 
 
 def get_draft_swa_ring_size(
@@ -1244,7 +1252,7 @@ def make_window_pool(size, layers):
 
         if (
             is_draft_worker
-            and not _is_hip
+            and (not _is_hip or uses_draft_swa_ring())
             and self.swa_kv_pool is not None
             and is_dspark_spec()
         ):

@@ -927,12 +927,15 @@ class TestEncoderReplayRequestWindowHip(CustomTestCase):
     class _Stop(Exception):
         pass
 
-    def _floor_passed(self, *, encoder_replay, swa_replay_start=None):
+    def _floor_passed(
+        self, *, encoder_replay, swa_replay_start=None, encoder_row_floor=None
+    ):
         backend = object.__new__(DeepseekV4HipRadixBackend)
         backend.token_to_kv_pool = SimpleNamespace(
             request_window=SimpleNamespace(capacity=256)
         )
         backend.encoder_replay = encoder_replay
+        backend.encoder_row_floor = encoder_row_floor
         seen = {}
 
         def fake_window_layout(req, pos, **kwargs):
@@ -966,6 +969,18 @@ def test_without_replay_the_caller_floor_passes_through(self):
             self._floor_passed(encoder_replay=False, swa_replay_start=start), start
         )
 
+    def test_folded_replay_floors_rows_and_pads_with_zero(self):
+        row_floor = torch.tensor([8, 8, 8, 0])
+        floor = self._floor_passed(encoder_replay=False, encoder_row_floor=row_floor)
+        self.assertEqual(floor.tolist(), [8, 8, 8, 0, 0])
+        start = torch.tensor([4, 4, 4, 7, 7])
+        self.assertIs(
+            self._floor_passed(
+                encoder_replay=False, swa_replay_start=start, encoder_row_floor=row_floor
+            ),
+            start,
+        )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
